summary_en: The paper combines a strongly dispersive disordered acoustic material with an AI decoder to encode an object's spatial information into a single measured frequency-domain signal. It experimentally reconstructs complex acoustic images from one acquisition by one stationary sensor, eliminating both phased-array acquisition and repeated mechanical or mask scanning. Because coded acquisition and physical image formation are the central contributions, it is a strong core addition to the acoustic coded-imaging collection.
